leads.arxiv: 2406.08747 (arXiv API: v1 2024-06-13; title: StreamBench: Towards Benchmarking Continuous Improvement of Language Agents)

community_list_entries.section: Resources / Benchmarks and Tasks / Comprehensive Evaluation
community_list_entries.name: StreamBench

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Benchmark (NeurIPS 2024 D&B) that scores continuous improvement of LLM agents over an input-feedback stream. All baselines (GrowPrompt, MemPrompt, Self-StreamICL, MAM-StreamICL) keep an 'external memory' of past instances and reuse it on later ones. Streams: text-to-SQL (Spider, CoSQL, BIRD), Python

phase1_verified_types.procedural_workflow: Sec.1: "with the goal to maximize the accuracy for the whole sequence of the agent's predictions"; Sec.3.1: "evaluate an agent by its aggregate metric at the final time step (T)"; Sec.4.1.2 MemPrompt/Self-StreamICL keep past feedback in external memory.
